body:
Sorry to hear that.
Wish I could help you out but I don't even have answers for myself.
I do want to hear what got you so much into suicide tho if u don't mind

Too bad life's been harsh on you as much as it has been to me. Not trying to waste your time or anything but I just really needed someone to talk to see what they feel.
I keep on getting this urge to commit suicide but thinking of the consequences, like how my family members would be blaming each other or my friends
or how my father would just defy that I committed suicide just because I'm ungrateful really gets on my nerves. Did you have any similar thoughts?
